title: Bali Phuket Tour Package
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the best of two destinations with a Bali Phuket tour that combines the tropical beauty of Bali and the vibrant energy of Phuket. Enjoy a Phuket Bali holiday package that includes a visit to the stunning Phi Phi Islands by speedboat, where you'll explore beautiful beaches and indulge in a delicious lunch. The itinerary also includes a tour of Nusa Penida’s famous beaches, and a scenic Phuket city tour, offering a perfect mix of relaxation and adventure with ample opportunities to create unforgettable memories.

know_before_you_go: Modest dress is essential—covering shoulders and knees when visiting temples. In Bali, wearing a sarong is customary in temples, and in Phuket, dressing appropriately for temples is a sign of respect for the local customs​.
Always ask for permission before taking photos, especially in local communities or during religious ceremonies in both Bali and Phuket. This shows respect for the local culture and privacy​.

In Bali, the Visa On Arrival (VOA) allows stays up to 30 days, extendable for an additional 30 days. Alternatively, travelers can apply for an e-Visa for short stays. In Phuket, the VOA permits a 15-day stay, with a Tourist Visa required for longer visits, granting up to 60 days. Ensure that your passport is valid for at least 6 months from your entry date​.
Dispose of waste properly and avoid using single-use plastics, as both Bali and Phuket are strict about maintaining cleanliness​.
Loud behavior, public intoxication, and inappropriate actions in sacred or public places can get you into trouble.

In Bali, don’t touch anyone on the head, as it's considered sacred, and always ask before taking photos, especially in religious or cultural settings. Phuket has similar customs, and it’s polite to greet locals with a slight bow or nod.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Kuta | Day at Leisure
days.desc: A warm welcome awaits you as you land at the airport in Kuta for the amazing Bali and Phuket tour. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel & check in. After relaxing for some time, head out to explore Kuta on your own. You may visit Kedonganan Beach, where golden sands & fresh seafood await against a stunning sunset backdrop. Alternatively, you may explore Pura Petitenget Temple, a sea temple showcasing Bali’s spiritual heritage. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Nusa Penida West Tour
days.desc: Set off on an adventure to Nusa Penida. Begin by getting driven to Sanur Harbour & from there board the speedboat for the Nusa Penida West Tour. Begin by strolling at Kelingking Beach, famous for its T-Rex-shaped cliff & stunning vistas. Next, visit Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool & Broken Bay, featuring a captivating coastal arch. As you head to Bubu Beach, admire the coastal views or try your hands on snorkelling (at extra cost). Later, get transferred back to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Phuket | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After check out, get driven to the airport & board the flight to Phuket, the next destination in your Phuket and Bali trip. Upon arriving, get transferred to the hotel & check in. Later, you may explore the city at your leisure. You can stroll through Banana Beach, famed for its vibrant coral reefs or marvel at Big Buddha, offering panoramic views of the island & surrounding beaches. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Island
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer to Phuket Marina to take the speedboat for the Phi Phi Islands tour. Your first stop will be Maya Bay, famous for its stunning beauty & crystal-clear waters. Next, visit Viking Cave, known for its ancient wall paintings. Afterwards, head to Monkey Beach & get a chance to see long-tailed macaques in their natural habitat. Continue by visiting Loh Samah Bay, surrounded by dramatic cliffs and vibrant marine life. Later, get transferred back to the hotel.

days.title: Phuket Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get ready & board the transfer for Phuket sightseeing tour. Begin with a visit to Karon Viewpoint, where you can take in panoramic views of the city’s stunning coastline. Next, explore the serene Wat Chalong Temple, a significant spiritual site in Phuket. After that, visit Phuket Old Town, where you can stroll through vibrant streets lined with a fascinating mix of Thai, Chinese, & European-style architecture. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
